metrics.name: Cohort retention, exact interval
metrics.definition: Share of an entry cohort returning with the specified value event in interval N.

formula_variables.returning_eligible: Distinct cohort members with return event in interval N
formula_variables.eligible_cohort: Cohort members with completed observation interval; >0
formula_variables.interval: Specified window, timezone and return-on convention

metrics.interpretation: Improvement may reflect value, targeting or changed event definition; compare matched cohorts.
metrics.why_it_matters: Supports a specific diagnosis when scope, time and denominator remain comparable.
metrics.update_frequency: At a cadence suitable for complete observation windows.
warnings: Immature intervals are excluded, not counted as failures.
Cannot equate usage retention with revenue retention.
limitations: No universal threshold; data quality and selection bias need review.
metrics.benchmark_context: No external benchmark adopted; compare like-for-like local cohorts.
recommended_actions: Verify denominator and cohort; investigate segment changes before intervention.
